title: Fibonacci-modulated growing Jacobi matrix
plain: Off-diagonal weights grow like √n but are doubled wherever the Fibonacci word has a 1. Periodic modulations give spectral phase transitions. Decide what this aperiodic one gives.
math: Let $f\in\{0,1\}^{\mathbb N}$ be the Fibonacci word and $J$ the Jacobi matrix with $a_n=\sqrt n\,(1+f_n)$, $b_n=0$. Determine the spectral type of $J$; in particular decide whether $J$ has absolutely continuous spectrum.
